{"id":1461681014,"question_id":69,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 7 months","timestamp":1732456070,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1461681014/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sqrt(x)","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int mySqrt(int x) {\n        int s=0;\n        int e=x;\n        int mid = s+(e-s)/2;\n        int ans=-1;\n        long long int product = mid *mid;\n        while(s<=e){\n            if(product==x){\n                return mid;\n            }\n            if(mid*mid<x){\n                ans=mid;\n                s=mid+1;\n            }\n            else{\n                e=mid-1;\n            }\n            mid= s+(e-s)/2;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sqrtx","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":70}
